disclaimer: This is a starter directory of official institutional entry points, not a list of currently open offers. Verify country eligibility, terms, deadlines, licensing, and availability on each official website before acting.

institutions.name: World Bank Group - Private Sector
institutions.description: Official entry point for private-sector investment and development finance information. Not a direct retail loan application.
institutions.eligibility_note: Products and eligibility depend on country, project size, sector, and instrument. Review official criteria.

institutions.name: World Bank - Business and Enterprise Resources
institutions.description: Official World Bank entry point for business-environment and country-level development information.
institutions.eligibility_note: Not a grant offer or guarantee of financing.

institutions.name: African Development Bank - Private Sector
institutions.description: Official entry point for African Development Bank private-sector operations and investment information.
institutions.eligibility_note: Financing is subject to program criteria and may target institutions or projects rather than individual startups.

institutions.name: African Development Bank - Procurement
institutions.description: Official entry point to procurement opportunities and notices associated with AfDB-financed activities.
institutions.eligibility_note: Tender-specific eligibility, deadlines, and documents apply. This is not a grant listing.

institutions.name: U.S. Small Business Administration - Funding Programs
institutions.description: Official overview of U.S. small-business funding programs, including loans and guarantees.
institutions.eligibility_note: Primarily U.S.-specific; check current citizenship, business, lender, and program requirements.

institutions.name: British Business Bank
institutions.description: Official UK entry point for business finance information and supported finance programs.
institutions.eligibility_note: UK-focused; program availability and eligibility vary.

institutions.name: European Commission - Funding & Tenders Portal
institutions.description: Official portal for EU funding calls, tenders, and program documentation.
institutions.eligibility_note: Each call defines eligible countries, organizations, costs, deadlines, and submission rules.

institutions.name: UN Global Marketplace
institutions.description: Official United Nations procurement portal where eligible vendors can review registration and tender opportunities.
institutions.eligibility_note: Supplier registration and each tender's qualification rules apply; not a grant program.

institutions.name: African Union
institutions.description: Official regional institution entry point; users should confirm specific current programs and calls from official notices.
institutions.eligibility_note: No currently open grant is asserted by this directory entry.
